problem: The graphs of y=x^2+4x+q and y=3x+10 have no points of intersection, where q is an integer. What is the least possible value of q?
notes: Original variant of Bedrock Prep's hard '2 Quadratics with No Solution' and 'Lowest Possible Sum' categories. The difference is x^2+x+q-10 with minimum q-41/4; no intersection requires q>41/4, so least integer q is 11. A calculator method should make the integer q condition explicit and check the two full graphs, not a single x sample. Source category: https://www.bedrockprep.com/problems
